"""Explicit private token actions. Never display paths, contents or raw errors."""
import hashlib
from localization import tr

def activate(addon):
    addon.setSetting('programme_tmdb46','true')
    addon.setSetting('tmdb_research43','true')
    from programme_refresh63 import request
    request()

def imported(choice,dialog,addon,gui,tokens):
    from token_write64 import note,read_destination
    note('SOURCE_SELECTION')
    if choice==7:
        raw=dialog.input(tr(36661),type=getattr(gui,'INPUT_ALPHANUM',0),option=getattr(gui,'ALPHANUM_HIDE_INPUT',1))
        if not raw:return
        raw=raw.encode('utf-8');value=tokens.validate(raw)
        if read_destination(tokens,tokens.location()) is None:
            addon.setSetting('tmdb_read_token43',value)
            tokens.effective_tmdb_read_token(force=True)
            dialog.ok(tr(36620),tr(36628));return
        dialog.ok(tr(36620),tr(36662))
    else:
        source=dialog.browseSingle(1,tr(36621),'files','.txt',False,False)
        if not source:return
        from tmdb_import63 import selected
        progress=None
        try:
            factory=getattr(gui,'DialogProgress',None)
            if factory is not None:
                progress=factory();progress.create(tr(36620),tr(36663))
            try:
                raw=selected(source,cancel=(lambda:progress.iscanceled()) if progress else lambda:False)
            except tokens.TokenError as error:
                error.stage='VFS_READ';note('VFS_READ','FAILED');raise
            note('VFS_READ')
        finally:
            if progress:progress.close()
        tokens.validate(raw);note('UTF8_FORMAT_VALIDATION')
    target=tokens.location()
    old=read_destination(tokens,target)
    expected=hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest() if old is not None else None
    if old is not None and not dialog.yesno(tr(36620),tr(36627),defaultbutton=getattr(gui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
    if choice==6 and not dialog.yesno(tr(36620),tr(36664),defaultbutton=getattr(gui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):return
    result=tokens.import_bytes(raw,expected,target=target)
    if tokens.location()!=target:raise tokens.TokenError('TOKEN_CHANGED')
    if choice==6:activate(addon)
    dialog.ok(tr(36620),tr(36628)+'\n'+tr(36665 if choice==6 else 36666)+('\n'+tr(36672) if result=='IMPORTED_SYNC_WARNING' else ''))

def show():
    import xbmcaddon,xbmcgui
    from menu_icons45 import select
    import tmdb_token61 as tokens
    dialog=xbmcgui.Dialog();addon=xbmcaddon.Addon()
    while True:
        state=tokens.status()
        labels=[tr(36621),tr({'FILE_VALID':36622,'FILE_MISSING':36623}.get(state,36624)),tr(36600),tr(36625),tr(36640),tr(36626),tr(36660),tr(36661)]
        choice=select(dialog,tr(36620),labels,actions=['settings','information','settings','check','back','check','settings','settings'])
        if not isinstance(choice,int) or not 0<=choice<len(labels) or choice==4:return
        if choice in (0,6,7):
            try:imported(choice,dialog,addon,xbmcgui,tokens)
            except (tokens.TokenError,OSError,UnicodeError) as exc:
                code=exc.code if isinstance(exc,tokens.TokenError) else 'TOKEN_UNREADABLE'
                stage=getattr(exc,'stage','UTF8_FORMAT_VALIDATION' if code=='TOKEN_FORMAT' else 'SOURCE_SELECTION')
                dialog.ok(tr(36620),tr(36674 if getattr(exc,'committed',False) else 36629,code)+'\n'+tr(36673,stage)+'\n'+tr(36667))
        elif choice==1:
            from token_write64 import diagnostic
            detail=diagnostic(tokens)
            dialog.ok(tr(36620),labels[1]+'\n'+detail['code']+' / '+detail['stage']+'\n'+tr(36630))
        elif choice==2:
            from tmdb_connection60 import launch
            launch()
        elif choice==3:
            if dialog.yesno(tr(36620),tr(36631),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):activate(addon)
        elif choice==5:
            if not dialog.yesno(tr(36620),tr(36632),defaultbutton=getattr(xbmcgui,'DLG_YESNO_NO_BTN',10)):continue
            addon.setSetting('programme_tmdb46','false');addon.setSetting('tmdb_research43','false')

msgctxt "#36627"

msgctxt "#36630"
msgid "Private profile file: tmdb_read_access_token.txt. The token is never displayed. Use the separate connection test to check authentication."
msgstr "Privater Profilordner: tmdb_read_access_token.txt. Der Token wird niemals angezeigt. Die Verbindung wird nur über den eigenen Testeintrag geprüft."

msgctxt "#36631"

msgstr "TMDB-Recherche und Sendungsbilder ausdrücklich aktivieren? Provider-Metadaten von Filmen und Serien bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36632"
msgid "Disable TMDB research and programme images? The private token file is retained."

msgid "Skinshortcuts: check / repair Python compatibility"

msgctxt "#36643"
msgid "Replace only the two shown getiterator calls with iter in the verified Skinshortcuts 2.1.0 file? A backup is retained; bindings and skin settings remain unchanged."

msgid "Restore the verified original file from this backup? Later external changes will not be overwritten."
msgstr "Die verifizierte Originaldatei aus der eigenen Sicherung wiederherstellen? Zwischenzeitliche fremde Änderungen werden nicht überschrieben."

msgctxt "#36645"
msgid "Compatibility check blocked. Requires the unmodified official Skinshortcuts 2.1.0, BINGIE 2.2.3, no playback or shortcut editor. Unknown or changed files are never overwritten."

msgctxt "#36646"
msgid "File verified and saved. Restart Kodi normally so Python loads the change. Do not delete caches. Then explicitly rebuild BINGIE Home once if needed."
msgstr "Datei verifiziert gespeichert. Kodi regulär neu starten, damit Python die Änderung lädt. Keine Caches löschen. Danach bei Bedarf das BINGIE-Home-Layout einmal ausdrücklich neu generieren."

msgctxt "#36647"
msgid "No matching verifiable Skinshortcuts backup found."
msgstr "Keine passende verifizierbare Skinshortcuts-Sicherung gefunden."

msgstr "Wiederherstellung betrifft ausschließlich library.py; Benutzerprofile, Widgetbindungen und Skin-Dateien bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36649"
msgid "The verified Skinshortcuts file is already Python compatible. No change needed."
msgstr "Die verifizierte Skinshortcuts-Datei ist bereits Python-kompatibel. Keine Änderung erforderlich."

msgctxt "#36660"
msgid "Import token and enable TMDB programme images"

msgctxt "#36661"
msgid "Enter/change token privately"

msgctxt "#36662"

msgstr "Eine private Token-Datei hat Vorrang. Die Eingabe ersetzt diese Datei erst nach Ihrer ausdrücklichen Bestätigung; kein stiller Wechsel zur alten Einstellung."

msgctxt "#36663"
msgid "Reading selected file within limits …"
msgstr "Ausgewählte Datei kontrolliert einlesen …"

msgctxt "#36664"
msgid "Save token only in this local Kodi profile and explicitly enable TMDB programme images? The token is never distributed."
msgstr "Token nur in diesem lokalen Kodi-Profil speichern und TMDB-Sendungsbilder ausdrücklich aktivieren? Es wird kein Token weitergegeben."

msgctxt "#36665"
msgid "TMDB programme images are enabled. Preparation runs in the background. Connection testing remains a separate action."
msgstr "TMDB-Sendungsbilder sind aktiviert. Die Vorbereitung läuft im Hintergrund. Der Verbindungstest ist separat erreichbar."

msgctxt "#36666"
msgid "Token stored privately. Image lookup was not enabled automatically."
msgstr "Token privat gespeichert. Die Bildsuche wurde nicht automatisch aktiviert."

msgctxt "#36667"
msgid "The file must contain one complete token on exactly one physical UTF-8 line. Visual editor wrapping is allowed; Bearer, JSON, BOM and extra lines are not. TOKEN_UNREADABLE can also indicate a VFS time budget or missing permission."
msgstr "Die Datei muss einen vollständigen Token in genau einer physischen UTF-8-Zeile enthalten. Ein visueller Editor-Umbruch ist erlaubt; Bearer, JSON, BOM und zusätzliche Zeilen nicht. TOKEN_UNREADABLE kann auch ein VFS-Zeitbudget oder fehlende Berechtigung bedeuten."

msgctxt "#36668"

msgstr "Noch {0} Min."

msgctxt "#36670"
msgid "Your previously approved, unchanged BINGIE layout can be upgraded to the full-bleed Hero. Existing widget sources and station buttons remain. Review the changes and then explicitly confirm."

msgctxt "#36672"
msgid "Token copied locally and verified. Directory synchronization is unconfirmed; check persistence after restarting Kodi."

msgid "A previous setup job is still closing. Please wait briefly and reopen the wizard."
msgstr "Ein vorheriger Einrichtungsauftrag wird noch beendet. Bitte kurz warten und den Assistenten erneut öffnen."

msgctxt "#36502"
msgid "Setup timed out. Cancellation has been requested. Existing portals are preserved. Check your connection and reopen; a running job will not be started twice."
msgstr "Zeitüberschreitung bei der Einrichtung. Der Auftrag wurde zum Abbruch aufgefordert. Bereits gespeicherte Portale bleiben erhalten. Bitte Verbindung prüfen und erneut öffnen; ein noch laufender Auftrag wird nicht doppelt gestartet."

msgctxt "#36503"
msgid "Displaying groups: {0} / {1}"
msgstr "Gruppen anzeigen: {0} / {1}"

msgctxt "#36504"
msgid "Updating selection markers …"
msgstr "Auswahlmarkierungen werden aktualisiert …"

msgctxt "#36505"
msgid "Saving setup: transferring data in verified batches …"
msgstr "Einrichtung speichern: Daten werden in geprüften Blöcken übertragen …"

msgctxt "#36506"
msgid "Saving setup: verifying saved data and index …"
msgstr "Einrichtung speichern: gespeicherte Daten und Index prüfen …"

msgctxt "#36510"
msgid "XCMate {0} is installed.\n\n• EPG manager: source comparison and live preview in the guide.\n• Automatic EPG updates every 24 hours by default, with readable reports.\n• Wizard: keep inputs and selected groups when errors occur.\n• Password remains available during Back and Retry in the current setup.\n\nAfter restarting Kodi, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and widgets are preserved."
msgstr "XCMate {0} ist installiert.\n\n• EPG-Manager: Quellenvergleich und Live-Vorschau im Raster.\n• EPG automatisch alle 24 Stunden als Standard, mit lesbaren Berichten.\n• Wizard: Eingaben und gewählte Gruppen bleiben bei Fehlern erhalten.\n• Das Passwort bleibt bei Zurück und Wiederholen in der laufenden Einrichtung erhalten.\n\nNach einem Kodi-Neustart muss ein nicht gespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Widgets bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36520"
msgid "Installation successful"
msgstr "Installation erfolgreich"

msgctxt "#36521"
msgid "Version {0}\n\nChanges:\n• Connection checked separately, with a clear success message.\n• Completed catalogue groups survive retries.\n• Portal saved before optional EPG imports.\n• EPG sources resume separately, with real progress and no total runtime limit.\n• New passwords remain editable during the running setup.\n• Clearer group counts and the regular XCMate background.\n\nAfter a new Kodi/Python session, an unsaved password must be entered again. Existing portals and settings are preserved."
msgstr "Version {0}\n\nÄnderungen:\n• Verbindung getrennt prüfen und Erfolg klar bestätigen.\n• Abgeschlossene Kataloggruppen bei Wiederholung erhalten.\n• Portal vor dem optionalen EPG-Import speichern.\n• EPG-Quellen einzeln fortsetzen, mit echtem Fortschritt und ohne Gesamtlaufzeitgrenze.\n• Neue Passwörter bleiben in der laufenden Einrichtung bearbeitbar.\n• Lesbare Gruppenzahlen und regulärer XCMate-Hintergrund.\n\nNach einer neuen Kodi-/Python-Sitzung muss ein ungespeichertes Passwort erneut eingegeben werden. Bestehende Portale und Einstellungen bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36530"
msgid "Approved programme image hosts (exact names, comma separated)"
msgstr "Freigegebene Sendungsbild-Hosts (exakte Namen, Komma getrennt)"

msgctxt "#36531"

msgstr "JETZT"

msgctxt "#36532"
msgid "Changes:"
msgstr "Änderungen:"

msgctxt "#36540"
msgid "Programme images from installed TMDb Helper (no personal API token)"
msgstr "Sendungsbilder über installierten TMDb Helper (ohne eigenen API-Token)"

msgctxt "#36541"
msgid "Reuse safely matched images from existing media catalogues"
msgstr "Sicher zugeordnete Bilder aus vorhandenen Medienkatalogen verwenden"

msgctxt "#36542"
msgid "Series image (not an episode still)"
msgstr "Serienbild (kein Episodenbild)"

msgctxt "#36600"
msgid "Test TMDB connection"
msgstr "TMDB-Verbindung testen"

msgctxt "#36610"
msgid "Set up BINGIE Home widgets"
msgstr "BINGIE-Startseiten-Widgets einrichten"

msgctxt "#36611"
msgid "Widget setup"
msgstr "Widget-Einrichtung"

msgctxt "#36612"
msgid "Native BINGIE widget management. Review and explicitly approve layout changes; existing sources and media rows are preserved."
msgstr "Echte BINGIE-Widgetverwaltung. Layout nur nach Vorschau und ausdrücklicher Bestätigung ändern; vorhandene Quellen und Medienreihen bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36613"
msgid "Check / prepare BINGIE Home layout"
msgstr "BINGIE-Home-Layout prüfen/vorbereiten"

msgctxt "#36614"
msgid "The verified adapter is already installed. If the live row is absent, rebuild Skinshortcuts once now? Saved widget bindings will stay unchanged."
msgstr "Der verifizierte Layoutadapter ist bereits vorhanden. Falls die Live-TV-Reihe fehlt: Skinshortcuts jetzt einmal neu generieren? Gespeicherte Widgetverknüpfungen werden nicht geändert."

msgctxt "#36615"
msgid "Rebuild once"
msgstr "Einmal neu generieren"

msgctxt "#36620"
msgid "TMDB access"
msgstr "TMDB-Zugang"

msgctxt "#36621"
msgid "Import token file"
msgstr "Token-Datei importieren"

msgctxt "#36622"
msgid "Token file present · valid format"
msgstr "Token-Datei vorhanden · Format gültig"

msgctxt "#36623"
msgid "Token file absent · legacy setting remains available"
msgstr "Token-Datei nicht vorhanden · bisheriges Einstellungsfeld bleibt verfügbar"

msgctxt "#36624"
msgid "Token file invalid or unsafe · no fallback"
msgstr "Token-Datei ungültig oder nicht sicher lesbar · kein Fallback"

msgctxt "#36625"
msgid "Enable TMDB programme images"
msgstr "TMDB-Sendungsbilder aktivieren"

msgctxt "#36626"
msgid "Disable TMDB programme images"
msgstr "TMDB-Sendungsbilder deaktivieren"

msgctxt "#36627"
msgid "Replace private token file? The existing file will be atomically replaced. The import source is retained."
msgstr "Private Token-Datei ersetzen? Die bisherige Datei wird atomar überschrieben. Die Importdatei bleibt erhalten."

msgctxt "#36628"
msgid "Token file imported. Artwork options remain unchanged until separately enabled."
msgstr "Token-Datei importiert. Bilder bleiben bis zur gesonderten Aktivierung unverändert."

msgctxt "#36629"
msgid "Import rejected: {0}. Choose a UTF-8 text file with one API Read Access Token without Bearer, quotes or JSON."
msgstr "Import abgelehnt: {0}. Eine UTF-8-Textdatei mit genau einem API Read Access Token ohne Bearer, Anführungszeichen oder JSON wählen."

msgctxt "#36630"
msgid "Private profile file: tmdb_read_access_token.txt. The token is never displayed. Use the separate connection test to check authentication."
msgstr "Privater Profilordner: tmdb_read_access_token.txt. Der Token wird niemals angezeigt. Die Verbindung wird nur über den eigenen Testeintrag geprüft."

msgctxt "#36631"
msgid "Explicitly enable TMDB research and programme images? Provider movie and series metadata remain unchanged."
msgstr "TMDB-Recherche und Sendungsbilder ausdrücklich aktivieren? Provider-Metadaten von Filmen und Serien bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36632"
msgid "Disable TMDB research and programme images? The private token file is retained."
msgstr "TMDB-Recherche und Sendungsbilder deaktivieren? Die private Token-Datei bleibt erhalten."

msgctxt "#36640"
msgid "Back"
msgstr "Zurück"

msgctxt "#36641"
msgid "Skinshortcuts: check / repair Python compatibility"
msgstr "Skinshortcuts: Python-Kompatibilität prüfen/reparieren"

msgctxt "#36642"
msgid "Restore Skinshortcuts backup"
msgstr "Skinshortcuts-Sicherung wiederherstellen"

msgctxt "#36643"
msgid "Replace only the two shown getiterator calls with iter in the verified Skinshortcuts 2.1.0 file? A backup is retained; bindings and skin settings remain unchanged."
msgstr "Nur die zwei gezeigten getiterator-Aufrufe in der verifizierten Skinshortcuts-2.1.0-Datei durch iter ersetzen? Sicherung bleibt erhalten; keine Bindungen oder Skin-Einstellungen werden geändert."

msgctxt "#36644"
msgid "Restore the verified original file from this backup? Later external changes will not be overwritten."
msgstr "Die verifizierte Originaldatei aus der eigenen Sicherung wiederherstellen? Zwischenzeitliche fremde Änderungen werden nicht überschrieben."

msgctxt "#36645"
msgid "Compatibility check blocked. Requires the unmodified official Skinshortcuts 2.1.0, BINGIE 2.2.3, no playback or shortcut editor. Unknown or changed files are never overwritten."
msgstr "Kompatibilitätsprüfung blockiert. Erwartet werden die unveränderte offizielle Skinshortcuts-Version 2.1.0, BINGIE 2.2.3 und keine laufende Wiedergabe/Shortcut-Bearbeitung. Unbekannte oder geänderte Dateien werden nicht überschrieben."

msgctxt "#36646"
msgid "File verified and saved. Restart Kodi normally so Python loads the change. Do not delete caches. Then explicitly rebuild BINGIE Home once if needed."
msgstr "Datei verifiziert gespeichert. Kodi regulär neu starten, damit Python die Änderung lädt. Keine Caches löschen. Danach bei Bedarf das BINGIE-Home-Layout einmal ausdrücklich neu generieren."

msgctxt "#36647"
msgid "No matching verifiable Skinshortcuts backup found."
msgstr "Keine passende verifizierbare Skinshortcuts-Sicherung gefunden."

msgctxt "#36648"
msgid "Restore affects only library.py; user profiles, widget bindings and skin files are retained."
msgstr "Wiederherstellung betrifft ausschließlich library.py; Benutzerprofile, Widgetbindungen und Skin-Dateien bleiben erhalten."

msgctxt "#36649"
msgid "The verified Skinshortcuts file is already Python compatible. No change needed."
msgstr "Die verifizierte Skinshortcuts-Datei ist bereits Python-kompatibel. Keine Änderung erforderlich."

msgctxt "#36660"
msgid "Import token and enable TMDB programme images"
msgstr "Token importieren und TMDB-Sendungsbilder aktivieren"

msgctxt "#36661"
msgid "Enter/change token privately"
msgstr "Token geschützt eingeben/ändern"

msgctxt "#36662"
msgid "A private token file takes precedence. Your entry replaces it only after explicit confirmation; no silent fallback to the legacy setting."
msgstr "Eine private Token-Datei hat Vorrang. Die Eingabe ersetzt diese Datei erst nach Ihrer ausdrücklichen Bestätigung; kein stiller Wechsel zur alten Einstellung."

msgctxt "#36663"
msgid "Reading selected file within limits …"
msgstr "Ausgewählte Datei kontrolliert einlesen …"

msgctxt "#36664"
msgid "Save token only in this local Kodi profile and explicitly enable TMDB programme images? The token is never distributed."
msgstr "Token nur in diesem lokalen Kodi-Profil speichern und TMDB-Sendungsbilder ausdrücklich aktivieren? Es wird kein Token weitergegeben."

msgctxt "#36665"
msgid "TMDB programme images are enabled. Preparation runs in the background. Connection testing remains a separate action."
msgstr "TMDB-Sendungsbilder sind aktiviert. Die Vorbereitung läuft im Hintergrund. Der Verbindungstest ist separat erreichbar."

msgctxt "#36666"
msgid "Token stored privately. Image lookup was not enabled automatically."
msgstr "Token privat gespeichert. Die Bildsuche wurde nicht automatisch aktiviert."

msgctxt "#36667"
msgid "The file must contain one complete token on exactly one physical UTF-8 line. Visual editor wrapping is allowed; Bearer, JSON, BOM and extra lines are not. TOKEN_UNREADABLE can also indicate a VFS time budget or missing permission."
msgstr "Die Datei muss einen vollständigen Token in genau einer physischen UTF-8-Zeile enthalten. Ein visueller Editor-Umbruch ist erlaubt; Bearer, JSON, BOM und zusätzliche Zeilen nicht. TOKEN_UNREADABLE kann auch ein VFS-Zeitbudget oder fehlende Berechtigung bedeuten."

msgctxt "#36668"
msgid "{0} min. remaining"
msgstr "Noch {0} Min."

msgctxt "#36669"
msgid "XCMate: update BINGIE Hero"
msgstr "XCMate: BINGIE-Hero aktualisieren"

msgctxt "#36670"
msgid "Your previously approved, unchanged BINGIE layout can be upgraded to the full-bleed Hero. Existing widget sources and station buttons remain. Review the changes and then explicitly confirm."
msgstr "Ihr bereits bestätigtes, unverändertes BINGIE-Layout kann auf den vollflächigen Hero umgestellt werden. Die bestehenden Widgetquellen und Senderbuttons bleiben erhalten. Prüfen Sie die Änderungen und bestätigen Sie anschließend ausdrücklich."

msgctxt "#36671"
msgid "Apply the verified Hero layout now, retain the verified backup and request the native Skinshortcuts rebuild? Cancel leaves skin files unchanged."
msgstr "Geprüftes Hero-Layout jetzt anwenden, verifizierte Sicherung behalten und den nativen Skinshortcuts-Neuaufbau starten? Abbrechen lässt die Skin-Dateien unverändert."

msgctxt "#36672"
msgid "Token copied locally and verified. Directory synchronization is unconfirmed; check persistence after restarting Kodi."
msgstr "Token lokal übernommen und geprüft. Die Verzeichnissynchronisierung ist nicht bestätigt; Persistenz nach Kodi-Neustart separat prüfen."

msgctxt "#36673"
msgid "Stage: {0}"
msgstr "Phase: {0}"

msgctxt "#36674"
msgid "Write already committed; final status unconfirmed: {0}"
msgstr "Schreibvorgang bereits erfolgt; endgültiger Status unbestätigt: {0}"

msgctxt "#36700"
msgid "Preserve the unreadable token entry and import a new private file?"
msgstr "Der vorhandene Token-Dateieintrag kann nicht sicher gelesen werden. Den Eintrag unverändert im privaten Profil sichern und anschließend eine neue Token-Datei importieren? Das Symlink-Ziel und andere Profildaten bleiben unberührt."

msgctxt "#36701"
msgid "Check groups and index status"
msgstr "Gruppen- und Indexstatus prüfen"

msgctxt "#36706"
msgid "Import this group again / retry"
msgstr "Gezielt nachimportieren / wiederholen"

msgctxt "#36707"
msgid "Cancel import of this group"
msgstr "Nachimport dieser Gruppe abbrechen"

msgctxt "#36708"
msgid "Back"
msgstr "Zurück"

msgctxt "#36710"
msgid "Status is unavailable. Existing data remains unchanged."
msgstr "Status derzeit nicht verfügbar. Bestehende Daten bleiben erhalten."

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<addon id="plugin.video.xtreammate"
       name="XCMate"
       version="0.1.29.64"
       provider-name="GS Media">

  <requires>
    <import addon="xbmc.python" version="3.0.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.pil" version="5.1.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.requests" version="2.27.0" optional="true"/>

</requires>

  <extension point="xbmc.python.pluginsource" library="default.py">
    <provides>video audio</provides>
  </extension>

  <extension point="xbmc.service" library="service.py" start="startup"/>

  <extension point="xbmc.addon.metadata">
    <summary lang="en_GB">XCMate – TV setup wizard for Xtream, M3U and Stalker</summary>
    <summary lang="de_DE">XCMate – IPTV-Einrichtungsassistent mit Xtream, M3U und Stalker</summary>
    <description lang="en_GB">
      Independent GPL-licensed derivative of mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi, featuring a guided IPTV import process and on-video remote-control live channel and category navigation.
      Features: Multiple M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API (Live/VOD/Series),
      XMLTV EPG, channel groups, favourites, search, catch-up, recordings,
      reminders, sleep timer.
    </description>
    <description lang="de_DE">
      Eigenständiger GPL-Fork von mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi mit geführter IPTV-Einrichtung und Fernbedienungssteuerung über laufendem Live-TV.
      Funktionen: Mehrere M3U-Playlists, Xtream-Codes-API (Live/VOD/Serien),
      XMLTV-EPG, Sendergruppen, Favoriten, Suche, Catch-up, Aufnahmen,
      Erinnerungen, Sleep-Timer.
    </description>
    <platform>all</platform>
    <license>GPL-2.0-only</license>
    <defaultlanguage>resource.language.en_gb</defaultlanguage>
    <forum>https://forum.kodi.tv</forum>
    <website>https://kodi.tv</website>
    <source>https://github.com/artattakk-creator/kodi-noodleprivate</source>
    <news>German and English language support; Language filter; Xtream auto-detection; Parallel search</news>
    <assets>
      <icon>icon-81da1003a2753ec6.png</icon>
      <fanart>resources/media/lightweight_splash.jpg</fanart>
    </assets>
  </extension>

</addon>

src/plugin.video.xtreammate/changelog.tx.old:
0.1.29.64
- BINGIE: Film-/Serienfokus an die jeweilige Kachel gebunden; Live-Senderleiste bleibt erhalten.
- Serien-Veröffentlichung nutzt die gemeinsame Provider-Bildreferenz und löst Aktualisierungen bei fertigen Postern aus.
- Hero: längere Titel lesbar; originales Space-Motiv bei fehlendem Sendungsbild.
- Bereits vorbereitete lokale EPG-Texte bleiben bei RAM-Cache-Verdrängung erhalten; Fokus im bestehenden Vorladen priorisiert.
- TMDB-Import mit getrennten Schreibphasen und Inhaltsprüfung nach atomarer Übernahme; Synchronisierungswarnungen verständlich melden.
- Token, Passwörter, Portale, Widgets, Cover und Wiedergabefortschritte bleiben erhalten.
- Android-Abnahme für Box B noch offen; keine Änderungen an Box A.

0.1.29.63
- BINGIE-Hero: bildfüllendes Breitbild mit transparentem Textoverlay gemäß bestätigtem Layout.
- Jetzt/Danach wird aus der gemeinsamen lokalen EPG-Datenbank geladen und warm an den Player übergeben.
- EPG-Text bleibt unabhängig von optionalen Bild-/Metadatenfehlern sichtbar.
- TMDB-Tokendateien können ausdrücklich über Kodi-VFS von USB/SMB lokal importiert werden.
- Getrennte Aktion für Import mit freiwilliger Aktivierung der Sendungsbilder; maskierte Eingabe als Alternative.
- Token, Passwörter, Portale und bestehende Widgets bleiben über das Update erhalten.
- Bekanntes BINGIE-Layout mit Vorschau, Zustimmung, Backup und Wiederherstellung aktualisierbar.

0.1.29.62
- Live-TV-Home liest die konfigurierte Startgruppe direkt aus einer lokalen Kataloggeneration.
- Senderbuttons bleiben bei fehlendem EPG, Artwork-Fehlern und beschädigten Zusatzmetadaten bedienbar.
- Stufendiagnose und streng auf die aktuelle Gruppe beschränkter LastGood-Fallback.
- TMDB-Menü: sichtbares Zurück ohne Einstellungsänderung; Aktivieren und Deaktivieren getrennt.

"""Local, versioned SQLite catalog. Writers run in workers; readers never HTTP.

The index contains IDs and provider metadata, never playable stream URLs.
No dependency on SQLite FTS/JSON extensions (not guaranteed by Android Kodi).
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time
import unicodedata

CATALOGS={'live':('get_live_streams','get_live_categories','stream_id'),
          'vod':('get_vod_streams','get_vod_categories','stream_id'),
          'series':('get_series','get_series_categories','series_id')}
FIELDS=('name','stream_icon','cover','cover_big','movie_image','backdrop_path','plot','description',
        'year','releaseDate','genre','rating','rating_5based','duration','duration_secs',
        'container_extension','epg_channel_id','source_key','series_flat',
        'language','languages','quality','video_quality','width','height',
        'num_seasons','season_count','seasons_count','original_name','original_title')
BATCH_ROWS=256


def normalized(value):
    value=unicodedata.normalize('NFKD',str(value or '').casefold())
    return ' '.join(''.join(c for c in value if not unicodedata.combining(c)).split())


def path():
    from utils import addon_data_dir
    return os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'library_v1.sqlite')


def connect(filename=None, write=False,timeout=2):
    filename=filename or path()
    if not write and not os.path.isfile(filename): return None
    db=sqlite3.connect(filename,timeout=timeout)
    db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    if write:
        from import_budget import check_space
        check_space(filename)
        db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
        db.execute('PRAGMA max_page_count=2147483646')
        db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS catalog(
          pid TEXT, kind TEXT, revision TEXT, updated REAL, PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS groups(pid TEXT, kind TEXT, cid TEXT, title TEXT,
          ordinal INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS titles(pid TEXT, kind TEXT, sid TEXT, cid TEXT,
          ordinal INTEGER, title TEXT, search TEXT, added INTEGER, payload TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,sid));
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS category_titles ON titles(pid,kind,cid,ordinal);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS recent_titles ON titles(pid,kind,added DESC,ordinal);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heads(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,cid TEXT,generation TEXT,
            updated REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items_v2(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,sid TEXT,cid TEXT,generation TEXT,
            ordinal INTEGER,title TEXT,search TEXT,added INTEGER,payload TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid,generation,sid));
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS group_order_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,cid,generation,ordinal);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS recent_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,added DESC);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS identity_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,sid);
          CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS readable_titles AS
            SELECT i.pid,i.kind,i.sid,i.cid,i.ordinal,i.title,i.search,i.added,i.payload
              FROM items_v2 i JOIN heads h USING(pid,kind,cid,generation)
            UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM titles t WHERE NOT EXISTS
              (SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=t.pid AND h.kind=t.kind AND h.cid=t.cid);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_status(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,cid TEXT,code TEXT,
            updated REAL,received INTEGER,stored INTEGER,discarded INTEGER,error TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_requests(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,priority INTEGER,
            preferred TEXT,force INTEGER,requested REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_leases(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,owner TEXT,until REAL,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));''')
    return db


def revision(client, actions):
    """File metadata, not repeated deserialization of huge catalog JSON files."""
    from utils import cache_dir, _private_cache_dir, addon_data_dir
    roots=set((cache_dir(),_private_cache_dir()))
    paths=[os.path.join(root,client._cache_key(a)+'.json') for root in roots for a in actions]
    paths.append(os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'xtreammate_groups.json'))
    values=[]
    for filename in paths:
        try:
            st=os.stat(filename); values.append((filename,st.st_mtime_ns,st.st_size))
        except OSError: values.append((filename,0,0))
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(values)).encode()).hexdigest()


def replace_catalog(pid,kind,entries,groups,allowed=None,seen=None,revision_id='',filename=None):
    from latest_media import added_timestamp
    if entries is None or isinstance(entries,(str,bytes,dict)): return False
    _,_,id_key=CATALOGS[kind]
    allowed=None if allowed is None else set(map(str,allowed))
    def rows():
        unique=set()
        for ordinal,item in enumerate(entries):
            if not isinstance(item,dict): continue
            sid=str(item.get(id_key) or ''); cid=str(item.get('category_id') or '')
            if not sid or sid in unique or (allowed is not None and cid not in allowed): continue
            unique.add(sid)
            title=str(item.get('name') or sid)[:512]
            payload={k:(item[k][:4096] if isinstance(item[k],str) else item[k][:8] if isinstance(item[k],list) else item[k])
                     for k in FIELDS if k in item}
            payload.update(sid=sid,category_id=cid,name=title,kind=kind)
            added=added_timestamp(item.get('added')) or added_timestamp(item.get('date_added')) or (seen or {}).get(sid)
            payload['added_at']=added
            yield (str(pid),kind,sid,cid,ordinal,title,normalized(title),added,json.dumps(payload))
    db=connect(filename,write=True)
    try:
        with db:
            db.execute('DELETE FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.execute('DELETE FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind))
            db.executemany('INSERT INTO titles VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',rows())
            db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[
                (pid,kind,str(g['category_id']),str(g.get('category_name') or g['category_id']),i)
                for i,g in enumerate(groups or []) if isinstance(g,dict) and g.get('category_id') is not None
                and (allowed is None or str(g['category_id']) in allowed)])
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,revision_id,time.time()))
        return True
    finally: db.close()


def refresh(portal,client,kinds=None):
    from group_selection import enabled_ids,load
    from latest_media import first_seen
    for kind in (kinds or CATALOGS):
        action,group_action,_=CATALOGS[kind]
        if not portal.get({'live':'include_live','vod':'include_vod','series':'include_series'}[kind],True):
            replace_catalog(portal['id'],kind,[],[])
            continue
        rev=revision(client,(action,group_action))
        state=Reader(portal['id']).state(kind)
        if state and state['revision']==rev: continue
        entries=client.get_cached_catalog(action)
        if not isinstance(entries,list): continue  # Keep previous valid snapshot.
        if not entries and state: continue  # Empty provider result must not empty widgets.
        groups=client.get_cached_catalog(group_action)
        if not isinstance(groups,list):
            groups=[{'category_id':cid,'category_name':cid} for cid in dict.fromkeys(
                str(e.get('category_id') or '') for e in entries if isinstance(e,dict))]
        allowed=enabled_ids(portal['id'],kind,groups)
        seen=first_seen(client._cache_key(action),action,entries) if kind!='live' else {}
        replace_catalog(portal['id'],kind,entries,groups,allowed,seen,rev)


class IndexReadError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class Reader:
    def __init__(self,pid,filename=None,timeout=2,query_seconds=None):
        self.pid,self.filename=str(pid),filename
        self._selections={}
        self.timeout,self.query_seconds=timeout,query_seconds

    def _filter(self,kind):
        from group_selection import enabled_ids
        groups=self._query('SELECT cid FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(self.pid,kind))
        self._selections[kind]=enabled_ids(self.pid,kind,[{'category_id':g['cid']} for g in groups])
        return ' AND cid IN (SELECT cid FROM selected_categories)'

    def _query(self,sql,args=(),kind=None):
        db=None
        try:
            db=connect(self.filename, timeout=self.timeout)
            if db is None: return []
            # A large catalogue or a temporarily locked legacy database must
            # not monopolize a skin widget/UI invocation. No partial result is
            # published; the caller receives an explicit, retryable error.
            if self.query_seconds is not None:
                deadline=time.monotonic()+self.query_seconds
                db.set_progress_handler(lambda: int(time.monotonic()>=deadline),1000)
            if 'titles' in sql and db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='readable_titles'").fetchone():
                sql=sql.replace('FROM titles','FROM readable_titles')
            if kind is not None:
                db.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE selected_categories(cid TEXT PRIMARY KEY)')
                db.executemany('INSERT INTO selected_categories VALUES(?)',[(cid,) for cid in self._selections[kind]])
            return [dict(r) for r in db.execute(sql,args)]
        except sqlite3.Error as exc: raise IndexReadError(type(exc).__name__) from exc
        finally:
            if db is not None: db.close()

    def state(self,kind):
        rows=self._query('SELECT * FROM catalog WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(self.pid,kind))
        return rows[0] if rows else None

    def groups(self,kind):
        return self._query('SELECT * FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?'+self._filter(kind)+' ORDER BY ordinal',(self.pid,kind),kind)

    def page(self,kind,query='',category=None,recent=False,offset=0,limit=48,pin=None,include_undated=False):
        where='pid=? AND kind=?'+self._filter(kind); args=[self.pid,kind]
        terms=[];term_args=[]
        for token in normalized(query).split():
            terms.append("search LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'")
            term_args.append('%'+token.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('%','\\%').replace('_','\\_')+'%')
        title_where=' AND '.join(terms) or '1'
        genre=None
        if query and kind in ('vod','series'):
            from genre_search import clause
            genre=clause(self,kind,query)
        if genre:
            where+=' AND (('+title_where+') OR ('+genre[0]+'))'
            args+=term_args+genre[1]
        elif terms:
            where+=' AND '+title_where;args+=term_args
        if category is not None: where+=' AND cid=?'; args.append(str(category))
        if recent and not include_undated: where+=' AND added IS NOT NULL'
        counts=self._query('SELECT count(DISTINCT sid) AS n FROM titles AS results WHERE '+where,args,kind)
        total=counts[0]['n'] if counts else 0
        order='added IS NULL,added DESC,ordinal' if recent else 'ordinal'
        if genre:
            order='CASE WHEN search=? THEN 0 WHEN '+title_where+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,'+order
            args=args+[normalized(query)]+term_args
        if pin:
            order='CASE WHEN sid=? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,'+order
            args=args[:-(1+len(term_args))]+[str(pin)]+args[-(1+len(term_args)):] if genre else args+[str(pin)]
        rows=self._query('SELECT payload FROM titles AS results WHERE '+where+' GROUP BY sid ORDER BY '+order+' LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
                         args+[max(1,min(int(limit),100)),max(0,int(offset))],kind)
        return [json.loads(r['payload']) for r in rows],total

    def get(self,kind,sid):
        rows=self._query('SELECT payload FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=?'+self._filter(kind),(self.pid,kind,str(sid)),kind)
        return json.loads(rows[0]['payload']) if rows else None

    def position(self,kind,sid,category):
        """Read-only ordinal position in one allowed group; never pin/reorder."""
        where='pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?'+self._filter(kind)
        args=[self.pid,kind,str(category)]
        rows=self._query('SELECT MIN(ordinal) AS n FROM titles WHERE '+where+' AND sid=?',args+[str(sid)],kind)
        ordinal=rows[0]['n'] if rows else None
        if ordinal is None:return None
        rows=self._query('SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sid) AS n FROM titles WHERE '+where+' AND ordinal<?',args+[ordinal],kind)
        return rows[0]['n'] if rows else None

    def rail(self,kind,offset=0,limit=24,keep=100):
        keep=max(24,min(int(keep),500))
        rows,total=self.page(kind,recent=True,include_undated=True,offset=offset,limit=min(limit,max(1,keep-offset)))
        return (rows if offset<keep else []),min(total,keep)


def initial_group(portal,groups,start_channel=None,last=''):
    allowed={str(g.get('cid',g.get('category_id',''))) for g in groups}
    candidates=[str((start_channel or {}).get('category_id') or ''),
                str(portal.get('start_group_id') or ''),str(last)]
    return next((cid for cid in candidates if cid in allowed),
                str(groups[0].get('cid',groups[0].get('category_id',''))) if groups else '')


def import_group(pid,kind,cid,entries,filename=None,cancel=lambda:False,progress=None,allowed=None):
    """Batch-committed staging; one small head swap exposes a complete group.

    Staging and previous generation coexist until validation finishes. A crash
    never publishes half JSON; a later sync restarts from the category endpoint.
    Unique SQLite keys replace unbounded Python duplicate/first-seen sets.
    """
    import uuid
    from latest_media import added_timestamp
    from import_budget import check_space
    cid,pid=str(cid),str(pid)
    generation=uuid.uuid4().hex
    db=connect(filename,write=True); target=filename or path()
    action,_,id_key=CATALOGS[kind]
    known_categories={r[0] for r in db.execute('SELECT cid FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? UNION SELECT cid FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind,pid,kind))}
    received=stored=discarded=0; batch=[];touched=set()
    allowed={cid} if allowed is None else set(map(str,allowed))
    def flush():
        nonlocal stored
        if not batch: return
        check_space(target,sum(len(row[-1]) for row in batch)*4)
        previous_changes=db.total_changes
        with db: db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO items_v2 VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',batch)
        stored+=db.total_changes-previous_changes
        batch.clear()
        if progress: progress(received,stored,discarded)
    try:
        # Clean only this group's abandoned, invisible generations. Bounded
        # deletion also avoids a giant cleanup transaction after a crash.
        _prune(db,pid,kind,cid)
        for item in entries:
            if cancel(): raise InterruptedError('catalogue import cancelled')
            received+=1
            if progress and received % BATCH_ROWS == 0: progress(received,stored,discarded)
            if not isinstance(item,dict): continue
            category=str(item.get('category_id') or '')
            if category not in allowed: discarded+=1;continue
            sid=str(item.get(id_key) or '')[:256]
            if not sid: continue
            title=str(item.get('name') or sid)[:512]
            payload={}
            for key in FIELDS:
                value=item.get(key)
                if isinstance(value,str): payload[key]=value[:4096]
                elif isinstance(value,(int,float,bool)) or value is None: payload[key]=value
                elif isinstance(value,list): payload[key]=[str(v)[:4096] for v in value[:8] if isinstance(v,(str,int,float))]
            added=added_timestamp(item.get('added')) or added_timestamp(item.get('date_added'))
            if not added:
                previous=db.execute('SELECT added FROM readable_titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=? LIMIT 1',
                                    (pid,kind,sid)).fetchone()
                added=previous[0] if previous else (int(time.time()) if category in known_categories else None)
            payload.update(sid=sid,category_id=category,name=title,kind=kind,added_at=added)
            touched.add(category)
            batch.append((pid,kind,sid,category,generation,received,title,normalized(title),added,json.dumps(payload)))
            if len(batch)>=BATCH_ROWS: flush()
        flush()
        if not stored:
            # Empty/filtered/error responses never erase a working group.
            raise ValueError('category response contains no usable entries')
        if cancel(): raise InterruptedError('catalogue import cancelled')
        check_space(target)
        with db:
            for category in touched:
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,category,category,0))
                db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO heads VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,category,generation,time.time()))
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,generation,time.time()))
        for category in touched: _prune(db,pid,kind,category)
        return dict(received=received,stored=stored,discarded=discarded,categories=sorted(touched))
    except BaseException:
        # Keep the previous head; remove only our uncommitted generation.
        try:
            with db: db.execute('DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND generation=?',
                                (pid,kind,generation))
        except sqlite3.Error: pass
        raise
    finally: db.close()


def _prune(db,pid,kind,cid):
    while True:
        with db:
            result=db.execute('''DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE rowid IN
              (SELECT i.rowid FROM items_v2 i WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=? AND NOT EXISTS
                (SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=i.pid AND h.kind=i.kind AND h.cid=i.cid
                 AND h.generation=i.generation) LIMIT 256)''',(pid,kind,cid))
        if result.rowcount<256: break


def sync_state(pid,kind,filename=None):
    db=connect(filename)
    if db is None: return []
    try:
        if not db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='sync_status'").fetchone(): return []
        return [dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM sync_status WHERE pid=? AND kind=? ORDER BY updated DESC',(pid,kind))]
    finally: db.close()


def _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,code,counts=None,exc=None,filename=None):
    from import_budget import safe_failure
    db=connect(filename,write=True)
    counts=counts or {}
    try:
        with db: db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_status VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
            (pid,kind,cid,code,time.time(),counts.get('received',0),counts.get('stored',0),counts.get('discarded',0),
             json.dumps(safe_failure(exc)) if exc else ''))
    finally: db.close()


def sync_kind(portal,client,kind,preferred='',force=False,cancel=lambda:False,filename=None,cached_only=False,max_groups=None,requested_at=None,only_categories=None):
    """One kind, enabled categories first, category API only; safe offline fallback."""
    from group_selection import enabled_ids
    import uuid
    pid=str(portal['id']); action,group_action,_=CATALOGS[kind]
    if not portal.get({'live':'include_live','vod':'include_vod','series':'include_series'}[kind],True): return
    db=connect(filename,write=True);owner=uuid.uuid4().hex
    try:
        with db:
            lease=db.execute('SELECT until FROM sync_leases WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind)).fetchone()
            if lease and lease[0]>time.time(): return
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_leases VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,owner,time.time()+330))
        groups=client.get_cached_catalog(group_action)
        if force and not cached_only:
            fresh=client._get_json(group_action,force_refresh=True)
            if isinstance(fresh,list) and fresh: groups=fresh
        if not isinstance(groups,list) and not cached_only:
            groups=client._get_json(group_action)
        if not isinstance(groups,list): raise FileNotFoundError('Category metadata unavailable')
        if only_categories is not None:
            missing=set(map(str,only_categories))-{str(g.get('category_id')) for g in groups}
            if missing and not cached_only:
                fresh=client._get_json(group_action,force_refresh=True)
                if isinstance(fresh,list):groups=fresh
                missing=set(map(str,only_categories))-{str(g.get('category_id')) for g in groups}
            if missing:raise FileNotFoundError('Requested category metadata unavailable')
        allowed=enabled_ids(pid,kind,groups)
        if only_categories is not None:allowed=set(allowed)&set(only_categories)
        active=[g for g in groups if str(g.get('category_id')) in allowed and (only_categories is None or str(g.get('category_id')) in only_categories)]
        active.sort(key=lambda g:str(g['category_id'])!=str(preferred))
        with db:
            db.executemany('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[
                (pid,kind,str(g['category_id']),str(g.get('category_name') or g['category_id']),i) for i,g in enumerate(groups)])
        completed=set();processed=0
        for group in active:
            if cancel(): return
            cid=str(group['category_id'])
            if cid in completed: continue
            head=db.execute('SELECT updated FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(pid,kind,cid)).fetchone()
            if head and ((not force and time.time()-head[0]<12*3600) or
                         (requested_at is not None and head[0]>=requested_at)): continue
            prior=db.execute('SELECT code,updated FROM sync_status WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(pid,kind,cid)).fetchone()
            if requested_at is not None and prior and prior[0] in ('FAILED','CANCELLED') and prior[1]>=requested_at: continue
            if max_groups is not None and processed>=max_groups: return True
            processed+=1
            with db: db.execute('UPDATE sync_leases SET until=? WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND owner=?',(time.time()+330,pid,kind,owner))
            _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'INDEXING',filename=filename)
            try:
                def progress(received,stored,discarded):
                    _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'INDEXING',dict(received=received,stored=stored,discarded=discarded),filename=filename)
                try:
                    entries=client.iter_catalog(action,cid,cached_only=cached_only,cancel=cancel)
                    counts=import_group(pid,kind,cid,entries,filename,cancel,progress,allowed)
                except (OSError,ConnectionError,TimeoutError):
                    if cached_only or head: raise
                    # Cold/offline upgrade only. A global cached array is
                    # scanned once for ALL active groups, never once per group.
                    counts=import_group(pid,kind,cid,client.iter_catalog(action,cid,cached_only=True,cancel=cancel),
                                        filename,cancel,progress,allowed)
                completed.update(counts['categories'])
                for category in counts['categories']:
                    _sync_note(pid,kind,category,'READY',counts,filename=filename)
            except Exception as exc:
                _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'CANCELLED' if isinstance(exc,InterruptedError) else 'FAILED',exc=exc,filename=filename)
                # Other enabled groups can succeed independently.
    finally:
        with db: db.execute('DELETE FROM sync_leases WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND owner=?',(pid,kind,owner))
        db.close()


def request_sync(portal,kind,preferred='',priority=20,force=False,filename=None):
    """Small persisted intent, consumed by one service worker. No network."""
    if kind not in CATALOGS or portal.get('type') not in ('xtream','m3u','stb'): return
    db=connect(filename,write=True,timeout=0.05)
    try:
        with db:
            db.execute('''INSERT INTO sync_requests VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)
              ON CONFLICT(pid,kind) DO UPDATE SET priority=min(priority,excluded.priority),
              preferred=CASE WHEN excluded.priority<=priority THEN excluded.preferred ELSE preferred END,
              force=max(force,excluded.force),
              requested=CASE WHEN excluded.force=1 THEN excluded.requested ELSE requested END''',
              (str(portal['id']),kind,int(priority),str(preferred),int(force),time.time()))
    finally: db.close()

"""Local, versioned SQLite catalog. Writers run in workers; readers never HTTP.

The index contains IDs and provider metadata, never playable stream URLs.
No dependency on SQLite FTS/JSON extensions (not guaranteed by Android Kodi).
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time
import unicodedata

CATALOGS={'live':('get_live_streams','get_live_categories','stream_id'),
          'vod':('get_vod_streams','get_vod_categories','stream_id'),
          'series':('get_series','get_series_categories','series_id')}
FIELDS=('name','stream_icon','cover','cover_big','movie_image','backdrop_path','plot','description',
        'year','releaseDate','genre','rating','rating_5based','duration','duration_secs',
        'container_extension','epg_channel_id','source_key','series_flat',
        'language','languages','quality','video_quality','width','height',
        'num_seasons','season_count','seasons_count','original_name','original_title')
BATCH_ROWS=256


def normalized(value):
    value=unicodedata.normalize('NFKD',str(value or '').casefold())
    return ' '.join(''.join(c for c in value if not unicodedata.combining(c)).split())


def path():
    from utils import addon_data_dir
    return os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'library_v1.sqlite')


def connect(filename=None, write=False,timeout=2):
    filename=filename or path()
    if not write and not os.path.isfile(filename): return None
    db=sqlite3.connect(filename,timeout=timeout)
    db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    if write:
        from import_budget import check_space
        check_space(filename)
        db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL')
        db.execute('PRAGMA max_page_count=2147483646')
        db.executescript('''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS catalog(
          pid TEXT, kind TEXT, revision TEXT, updated REAL, PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS groups(pid TEXT, kind TEXT, cid TEXT, title TEXT,
          ordinal INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS titles(pid TEXT, kind TEXT, sid TEXT, cid TEXT,
          ordinal INTEGER, title TEXT, search TEXT, added INTEGER, payload TEXT,
          PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,sid));
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS category_titles ON titles(pid,kind,cid,ordinal);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS recent_titles ON titles(pid,kind,added DESC,ordinal);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heads(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,cid TEXT,generation TEXT,
            updated REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items_v2(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,sid TEXT,cid TEXT,generation TEXT,
            ordinal INTEGER,title TEXT,search TEXT,added INTEGER,payload TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid,generation,sid));
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS group_order_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,cid,generation,ordinal);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS recent_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,added DESC);
          CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS identity_v2 ON items_v2(pid,kind,sid);
          CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS readable_titles AS
            SELECT i.pid,i.kind,i.sid,i.cid,i.ordinal,i.title,i.search,i.added,i.payload
              FROM items_v2 i JOIN heads h USING(pid,kind,cid,generation)
            UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM titles t WHERE NOT EXISTS
              (SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=t.pid AND h.kind=t.kind AND h.cid=t.cid);
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_status(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,cid TEXT,code TEXT,
            updated REAL,received INTEGER,stored INTEGER,discarded INTEGER,error TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,cid));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_requests(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,priority INTEGER,
            preferred TEXT,force INTEGER,requested REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));
          CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_leases(pid TEXT,kind TEXT,owner TEXT,until REAL,
            PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind));''')
    return db


def revision(client, actions):
    """File metadata, not repeated deserialization of huge catalog JSON files."""
    from utils import cache_dir, _private_cache_dir, addon_data_dir
    roots=set((cache_dir(),_private_cache_dir()))
    paths=[os.path.join(root,client._cache_key(a)+'.json') for root in roots for a in actions]
    paths.append(os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'xtreammate_groups.json'))
    values=[]
    for filename in paths:
        try:
            st=os.stat(filename); values.append((filename,st.st_mtime_ns,st.st_size))
        except OSError: values.append((filename,0,0))
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(values)).encode()).hexdigest()


def replace_catalog(pid,kind,entries,groups,allowed=None,seen=None,revision_id='',filename=None,authoritative=True):
    from latest_media import added_timestamp
    if entries is None or isinstance(entries,(str,bytes,dict)): return False
    _,_,id_key=CATALOGS[kind]
    allowed=None if allowed is None else set(map(str,allowed))
    def rows():
        unique=set()
        for ordinal,item in enumerate(entries):
            if not isinstance(item,dict): continue
            sid=str(item.get(id_key) if item.get(id_key) is not None else ''); cid=str(item.get('category_id') if item.get('category_id') is not None else '')
            if not sid or sid in unique or (allowed is not None and cid not in allowed): continue
            unique.add(sid)
            title=str(item.get('name') or sid)[:512]
            payload={k:(item[k][:4096] if isinstance(item[k],str) else item[k][:8] if isinstance(item[k],list) else item[k])
                     for k in FIELDS if k in item}
            payload.update(sid=sid,category_id=cid,name=title,kind=kind)
            added=added_timestamp(item.get('added')) or added_timestamp(item.get('date_added')) or (seen or {}).get(sid)
            payload['added_at']=added
            yield (str(pid),kind,sid,cid,ordinal,title,normalized(title),added,json.dumps(payload))
    db=connect(filename,write=True)
    try:
        with db:
            # A legacy cache bridge may not invalidate published generations.
            if authoritative:
                db.execute('DELETE FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=titles.pid AND h.kind=titles.kind AND h.cid=titles.cid)',(pid,kind))
                db.execute('DELETE FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=groups.pid AND h.kind=groups.kind AND h.cid=groups.cid)',(pid,kind))
            db.executemany('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO titles VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',rows())
            db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[
                (pid,kind,str(g['category_id']),str(g.get('category_name') or g['category_id']),i)
                for i,g in enumerate(groups or []) if isinstance(g,dict) and g.get('category_id') is not None
                and (allowed is None or str(g['category_id']) in allowed)])
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,revision_id,time.time()))
        return True
    finally: db.close()


def refresh(portal,client,kinds=None):
    from group_selection import enabled_ids,load
    from latest_media import first_seen
    for kind in (kinds or CATALOGS):
        action,group_action,_=CATALOGS[kind]
        if not portal.get({'live':'include_live','vod':'include_vod','series':'include_series'}[kind],True):
            replace_catalog(portal['id'],kind,[],[],authoritative=False)
            continue
        rev=revision(client,(action,group_action))
        state=Reader(portal['id']).state(kind)
        if state and state['revision']==rev: continue
        entries=client.get_cached_catalog(action)
        if not isinstance(entries,list): continue  # Keep previous valid snapshot.
        if not entries and state: continue  # Empty provider result must not empty widgets.
        groups=client.get_cached_catalog(group_action)
        if not isinstance(groups,list):
            groups=[{'category_id':cid,'category_name':cid} for cid in dict.fromkeys(
                str(e.get('category_id') or '') for e in entries if isinstance(e,dict))]
        allowed=enabled_ids(portal['id'],kind,groups)
        seen=first_seen(client._cache_key(action),action,entries) if kind!='live' else {}
        replace_catalog(portal['id'],kind,entries,groups,allowed,seen,rev,authoritative=False)


class IndexReadError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class Reader:
    def __init__(self,pid,filename=None,timeout=2,query_seconds=None):
        self.pid,self.filename=str(pid),filename
        self._selections={}
        self.timeout,self.query_seconds=timeout,query_seconds

    def _filter(self,kind):
        from group_selection import enabled_ids
        groups=self._query('SELECT cid FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(self.pid,kind))
        self._selections[kind]=enabled_ids(self.pid,kind,[{'category_id':g['cid']} for g in groups])
        return ' AND cid IN (SELECT cid FROM selected_categories)'

    def _query(self,sql,args=(),kind=None):
        db=None
        try:
            db=connect(self.filename, timeout=self.timeout)
            if db is None: return []
            # A large catalogue or a temporarily locked legacy database must
            # not monopolize a skin widget/UI invocation. No partial result is
            # published; the caller receives an explicit, retryable error.
            if self.query_seconds is not None:
                deadline=time.monotonic()+self.query_seconds
                db.set_progress_handler(lambda: int(time.monotonic()>=deadline),1000)
            if 'titles' in sql and db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='readable_titles'").fetchone():
                sql=sql.replace('FROM titles','FROM readable_titles')
            if kind is not None:
                db.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE selected_categories(cid TEXT PRIMARY KEY)')
                db.executemany('INSERT INTO selected_categories VALUES(?)',[(cid,) for cid in self._selections[kind]])
            return [dict(r) for r in db.execute(sql,args)]
        except sqlite3.Error as exc: raise IndexReadError(type(exc).__name__) from exc
        finally:
            if db is not None: db.close()

    def state(self,kind):
        rows=self._query('SELECT * FROM catalog WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(self.pid,kind))
        return rows[0] if rows else None

    def groups(self,kind):
        return self._query('SELECT * FROM groups WHERE pid=? AND kind=?'+self._filter(kind)+' ORDER BY ordinal',(self.pid,kind),kind)

    def page(self,kind,query='',category=None,recent=False,offset=0,limit=48,pin=None,include_undated=False):
        where='pid=? AND kind=?'+self._filter(kind); args=[self.pid,kind]
        terms=[];term_args=[]
        for token in normalized(query).split():
            terms.append("search LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'")
            term_args.append('%'+token.replace('\\','\\\\').replace('%','\\%').replace('_','\\_')+'%')
        title_where=' AND '.join(terms) or '1'
        genre=None
        if query and kind in ('vod','series'):
            from genre_search import clause
            genre=clause(self,kind,query)
        if genre:
            where+=' AND (('+title_where+') OR ('+genre[0]+'))'
            args+=term_args+genre[1]
        elif terms:
            where+=' AND '+title_where;args+=term_args
        if category is not None: where+=' AND cid=?'; args.append(str(category))
        if recent and not include_undated: where+=' AND added IS NOT NULL'
        counts=self._query('SELECT count(DISTINCT sid) AS n FROM titles AS results WHERE '+where,args,kind)
        total=counts[0]['n'] if counts else 0
        order='added IS NULL,added DESC,ordinal' if recent else 'ordinal'
        if genre:
            order='CASE WHEN search=? THEN 0 WHEN '+title_where+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,'+order
            args=args+[normalized(query)]+term_args
        if pin:
            order='CASE WHEN sid=? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,'+order
            args=args[:-(1+len(term_args))]+[str(pin)]+args[-(1+len(term_args)):] if genre else args+[str(pin)]
        rows=self._query('SELECT payload FROM titles AS results WHERE '+where+' GROUP BY sid ORDER BY '+order+' LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
                         args+[max(1,min(int(limit),100)),max(0,int(offset))],kind)
        return [json.loads(r['payload']) for r in rows],total

    def get(self,kind,sid):
        rows=self._query('SELECT payload FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=?'+self._filter(kind),(self.pid,kind,str(sid)),kind)
        return json.loads(rows[0]['payload']) if rows else None

    def position(self,kind,sid,category):
        """Read-only ordinal position in one allowed group; never pin/reorder."""
        where='pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?'+self._filter(kind)
        args=[self.pid,kind,str(category)]
        rows=self._query('SELECT MIN(ordinal) AS n FROM titles WHERE '+where+' AND sid=?',args+[str(sid)],kind)
        ordinal=rows[0]['n'] if rows else None
        if ordinal is None:return None
        rows=self._query('SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sid) AS n FROM titles WHERE '+where+' AND ordinal<?',args+[ordinal],kind)
        return rows[0]['n'] if rows else None

    def rail(self,kind,offset=0,limit=24,keep=100):
        keep=max(24,min(int(keep),500))
        rows,total=self.page(kind,recent=True,include_undated=True,offset=offset,limit=min(limit,max(1,keep-offset)))
        return (rows if offset<keep else []),min(total,keep)


def initial_group(portal,groups,start_channel=None,last=''):
    allowed={str(g.get('cid',g.get('category_id',''))) for g in groups}
    candidates=[str((start_channel or {}).get('category_id') or ''),
                str(portal.get('start_group_id') or ''),str(last)]
    return next((cid for cid in candidates if cid in allowed),
                str(groups[0].get('cid',groups[0].get('category_id',''))) if groups else '')


def import_group(pid,kind,cid,entries,filename=None,cancel=lambda:False,progress=None,allowed=None):
    """Batch-committed staging; one small head swap exposes a complete group.

    Staging and previous generation coexist until validation finishes. A crash
    never publishes half JSON; a later sync restarts from the category endpoint.
    Unique SQLite keys replace unbounded Python duplicate/first-seen sets.
    """
    import uuid
    from latest_media import added_timestamp
    from import_budget import check_space
    cid,pid=str(cid),str(pid)
    generation=uuid.uuid4().hex
    db=connect(filename,write=True); target=filename or path()
    action,_,id_key=CATALOGS[kind]
    known_categories={r[0] for r in db.execute('SELECT cid FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? UNION SELECT cid FROM titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind,pid,kind))}
    received=stored=discarded=0; batch=[];touched=set()
    allowed={cid} if allowed is None else set(map(str,allowed))
    def flush():
        nonlocal stored
        if not batch: return
        check_space(target,sum(len(row[-1]) for row in batch)*4)
        previous_changes=db.total_changes
        with db: db.executemany('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO items_v2 VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',batch)
        stored+=db.total_changes-previous_changes
        batch.clear()
        if progress: progress(received,stored,discarded)
    try:
        # Clean only this group's abandoned, invisible generations. Bounded
        # deletion also avoids a giant cleanup transaction after a crash.
        _prune(db,pid,kind,cid)
        for item in entries:
            if cancel(): raise InterruptedError('catalogue import cancelled')
            received+=1
            if progress and received % BATCH_ROWS == 0: progress(received,stored,discarded)
            if not isinstance(item,dict): continue
            category=str(item.get('category_id') if item.get('category_id') is not None else '')
            if category not in allowed: discarded+=1;continue
            sid=str(item.get(id_key) if item.get(id_key) is not None else '')[:256]
            if not sid: continue
            title=str(item.get('name') or sid)[:512]
            payload={}
            for key in FIELDS:
                value=item.get(key)
                if isinstance(value,str): payload[key]=value[:4096]
                elif isinstance(value,(int,float,bool)) or value is None: payload[key]=value
                elif isinstance(value,list): payload[key]=[str(v)[:4096] for v in value[:8] if isinstance(v,(str,int,float))]
            added=added_timestamp(item.get('added')) or added_timestamp(item.get('date_added'))
            if not added:
                previous=db.execute('SELECT added FROM readable_titles WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=? LIMIT 1',
                                    (pid,kind,sid)).fetchone()
                added=previous[0] if previous else (int(time.time()) if category in known_categories else None)
            payload.update(sid=sid,category_id=category,name=title,kind=kind,added_at=added)
            touched.add(category)
            batch.append((pid,kind,sid,category,generation,received,title,normalized(title),added,json.dumps(payload)))
            if len(batch)>=BATCH_ROWS: flush()
        flush()
        if not stored:
            # Empty/filtered/error responses never erase a working group.
            from catalog_guard65 import EmptyCategory65
            raise EmptyCategory65(received,discarded)
        if cancel(): raise InterruptedError('catalogue import cancelled')
        check_space(target)
        with db:
            for category in touched:
                db.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,category,category,0))
                db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO heads VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,category,generation,time.time()))
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO catalog VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,generation,time.time()))
        for category in touched: _prune(db,pid,kind,category)
        return dict(received=received,stored=stored,discarded=discarded,categories=sorted(touched))
    except BaseException:
        # Keep the previous head; remove only our uncommitted generation.
        try:
            with db: db.execute('DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND generation=?',
                                (pid,kind,generation))
        except sqlite3.Error: pass
        raise
    finally: db.close()


def _prune(db,pid,kind,cid):
    while True:
        with db:
            result=db.execute('''DELETE FROM items_v2 WHERE rowid IN
              (SELECT i.rowid FROM items_v2 i WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=? AND NOT EXISTS
                (SELECT 1 FROM heads h WHERE h.pid=i.pid AND h.kind=i.kind AND h.cid=i.cid
                 AND h.generation=i.generation) LIMIT 256)''',(pid,kind,cid))
        if result.rowcount<256: break


def sync_state(pid,kind,filename=None):
    db=connect(filename)
    if db is None: return []
    try:
        if not db.execute("SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='sync_status'").fetchone(): return []
        return [dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT * FROM sync_status WHERE pid=? AND kind=? ORDER BY updated DESC',(pid,kind))]
    finally: db.close()


def _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,code,counts=None,exc=None,filename=None):
    from import_budget import safe_failure
    db=connect(filename,write=True)
    counts=counts or {}
    try:
        with db: db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_status VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
            (pid,kind,cid,code,time.time(),counts.get('received',0),counts.get('stored',0),counts.get('discarded',0),
             json.dumps(safe_failure(exc)) if exc else ''))

def sync_kind(portal,client,kind,preferred='',force=False,cancel=lambda:False,filename=None,cached_only=False,max_groups=None,requested_at=None,only_categories=None):
    """One kind, enabled categories first, category API only; safe offline fallback."""
    from group_selection import enabled_ids
    import uuid
    pid=str(portal['id']); action,group_action,_=CATALOGS[kind]
    if not portal.get({'live':'include_live','vod':'include_vod','series':'include_series'}[kind],True): return
    db=connect(filename,write=True);owner=uuid.uuid4().hex
    try:
        with db:
            db.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE')
            lease=db.execute('SELECT until FROM sync_leases WHERE pid=? AND kind=?',(pid,kind)).fetchone()
            if lease and lease[0]>time.time(): return True  # Work remains; never consume the queued intent.
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO sync_leases VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(pid,kind,owner,time.time()+330))
        groups=client.get_cached_catalog(group_action)
        if force and not cached_only and only_categories is None:
            fresh=client._get_json(group_action,force_refresh=True)
            if isinstance(fresh,list) and fresh: groups=fresh
        if not isinstance(groups,list) and not cached_only:
            groups=client._get_json(group_action)
        if not isinstance(groups,list): raise FileNotFoundError('Category metadata unavailable')
        if only_categories is not None:
            missing=set(map(str,only_categories))-{str(g.get('category_id')) for g in groups}
            if missing and not cached_only:
                fresh=client._get_json(group_action,force_refresh=True)
                if isinstance(fresh,list):groups=fresh
                missing=set(map(str,only_categories))-{str(g.get('category_id')) for g in groups}
            if missing:raise FileNotFoundError('Requested category metadata unavailable')
        allowed=enabled_ids(pid,kind,groups)
        if only_categories is not None:allowed=set(allowed)&set(only_categories)
        active=[g for g in groups if str(g.get('category_id')) in allowed and (only_categories is None or str(g.get('category_id')) in only_categories)]
        active.sort(key=lambda g:str(g['category_id'])!=str(preferred))
        with db:
            db.executemany('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO groups VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',[
                (pid,kind,str(g['category_id']),str(g.get('category_name') or g['category_id']),i) for i,g in enumerate(groups)])
        completed=set();processed=0
        for group in active:
            if cancel(): return
            cid=str(group['category_id'])
            if cid in completed: continue
            head=db.execute('SELECT updated FROM heads WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(pid,kind,cid)).fetchone()
            if head and ((not force and time.time()-head[0]<12*3600) or
                         (requested_at is not None and head[0]>=requested_at)): continue
            prior=db.execute('SELECT code,updated FROM sync_status WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND cid=?',(pid,kind,cid)).fetchone()
            if requested_at is not None and prior and prior[0] in ('FAILED','CANCELLED','SOURCE_EMPTY','SOURCE_FILTERED') and prior[1]>=requested_at: continue
            if max_groups is not None and processed>=max_groups: return True
            processed+=1
            with db: db.execute('UPDATE sync_leases SET until=? WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND owner=?',(time.time()+330,pid,kind,owner))
            _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'INDEXING',filename=filename)
            from catalog_guard65 import EmptyCategory65,note as evidence65,cold_categories,selected_cancel
            group_cancel65=selected_cancel(pid,kind,groups,cid,cancel)
            transport65='LOCAL_CACHE' if cached_only else 'REMOTE'
            try:
                def progress(received,stored,discarded):
                    _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,'INDEXING',dict(received=received,stored=stored,discarded=discarded),filename=filename)
                try:
                    entries=client.iter_catalog(action,cid,cached_only=cached_only,cancel=cancel)
                    counts=import_group(pid,kind,cid,entries,filename,group_cancel65,progress,{cid})
                except (OSError,ConnectionError,TimeoutError,EmptyCategory65) as source_error65:
                    if isinstance(source_error65,EmptyCategory65):
                        source_counts65=dict(received=source_error65.received,stored=0,discarded=source_error65.discarded)
                        evidence65(pid,kind,cid,str(source_error65),source_counts65,filename=filename)
                    if cached_only or head: raise
                    fallback65=cold_categories(db,pid,kind,allowed)
                    if not fallback65:raise
                    transport65='LOCAL_CACHE'
                    # Cold/offline upgrade only. A global cached array is
                    # scanned once for ALL active groups, never once per group.
                    try:
                        counts=import_group(pid,kind,cid,client.iter_catalog(action,cid,cached_only=True,cancel=cancel),filename,group_cancel65,progress,fallback65)
                    except InterruptedError:raise
                    except (OSError,ValueError):
                        if isinstance(source_error65,EmptyCategory65):raise source_error65
                        raise OSError('CACHE_UNAVAILABLE') from None
                completed.update(counts['categories'])
                for category in counts['categories']:
                    _sync_note(pid,kind,category,'READY' if transport65=='REMOTE' else 'CACHED',counts,filename=filename)
                    evidence65(pid,kind,category,'READY' if transport65=='REMOTE' else 'CACHED',counts,transport65,filename)
            except Exception as exc:
                code65=str(exc) if isinstance(exc,EmptyCategory65) else 'CANCELLED' if isinstance(exc,InterruptedError) else 'FAILED'
                counts65=dict(received=exc.received,stored=0,discarded=exc.discarded) if isinstance(exc,EmptyCategory65) else {}
                _sync_note(pid,kind,cid,code65,counts65,exc=exc,filename=filename)
                evidence65(pid,kind,cid,code65,counts65,filename=filename)
                # Other enabled groups can succeed independently.
    finally:
        with db: db.execute('DELETE FROM sync_leases WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND owner=?',(pid,kind,owner))
        db.close()


def request_sync(portal,kind,preferred='',priority=20,force=False,filename=None):
    """Small persisted intent, consumed by one service worker. No network."""
    if kind not in CATALOGS or portal.get('type') not in ('xtream','m3u','stb'): return
    db=connect(filename,write=True,timeout=0.05)
    try:
        with db:
            db.execute('''INSERT INTO sync_requests VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)
              ON CONFLICT(pid,kind) DO UPDATE SET priority=min(priority,excluded.priority),
              preferred=CASE WHEN excluded.priority<=priority THEN excluded.preferred ELSE preferred END,
              force=max(force,excluded.force),
              requested=CASE WHEN excluded.force=1 THEN excluded.requested ELSE requested END''',
              (str(portal['id']),kind,int(priority),str(preferred),int(force),time.time()))
    finally: db.close()
